# Create Skill Prompt

Use this prompt when you want help writing a new `SKILL.md` file for this repository.

## What it does

- asks for the purpose of the skill
- suggests the right file location and name
- generates valid frontmatter
- creates a brief workflow and validation checklist

## Example Usage

- `Create a SKILL.md file for repo-specific agent customization.`
- `Help me write a workspace skill for adding a new agent customization workflow.`
- `Generate a SKILL.md file and validation checklist for this repo.`
